values.value: Seller will not be responsible for demurrage or despatch unless a claim is filed in writing, by the Buyer, within 90 days of completion of discharge. Such claim to include amount due, laytime calculations and applicable time sheets. After Buyer has received the laytime calculations for demurrage or despatch Buyer will have 30 days to notify Seller of their agreement or disagreement; if Seller does not receive any response within this period, it is understood that Buyer accepts the calculations and agrees to pay any demurrage at sight without further recourse.
